name: caption-generator

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,python -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "cd python-service && uvicorn main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"
scripts.dev:no-python: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server

description: Offline MERN caption burner using FFmpeg
